name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-10-09, at wavelengths from 0.90 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
